text: Outdoor garden ceremony with string lights and seasonal flowers for a romantic vibe.
Buffet with live stations (pasta, chaat) keeps guests engaged and reduces per-plate cost.
Photo booth with props and instant prints doubles as guest favor and entertainment.
Themed dessert table with custom cake topper matching the party theme.
Interactive games (trivia, karaoke) keep energy high for mixed-age groups.
Potluck-style food with assigned dishes ensures variety and lowers catering cost.
Volunteer-run registration desk and clear signage reduce bottlenecks at entry.
Send digital invitations 6 weeks ahead with RSVP tracking and dietary capture.
Create a day-of timeline shared with all vendors to keep everyone aligned.
